changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwicdcategory AS SELECT ic.category_code, ic.icd_coding, ic.category_name, ic.category_description, ic.parent_category_code FROM public.icd_category ic;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwicdcategory TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwicdcategory FROM report_user;
